title: A Sharp Signal-to-Noise Threshold for Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Breakpoint Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.12271v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish a sharp pathwise signal-to-noise criterion for quasi-maximum-likelihood (QML) estimation of a dominant breakpoint in the second-moment structure of a multivariate time series: the QML estimator is consistent whenever the between-regime contrast exceeds the within-regime fluctuation by an explicit factor, and below this threshold global recovery can fail. Two innovations drive the result. First, the framework is pathwise: no stochastic model is imposed on the data. Second, the log-determinant objective carries an additive ridge regularization: it removes the endpoint boundary layers, so no trimming of the candidate set is required, and tuning the ridge weakens the consistency condition. As an application of the main theorem, we establish consistency of QML breakpoint estimation in pervasive factor models whose dimension diverges with the sample size, for completely general error terms -- not necessarily independent, idiosyn

translated_title: 拟极大似然断点估计的尖锐信噪比阈值
translated_abstract: 我们为多元时间序列二阶矩结构中主导断点的拟极大似然（QML）估计建立了一个尖锐的逐路径信噪比准则：只要区间间对比度超过区间内波动一个明确的因子，QML估计量便是一致的；而低于该阈值时，全局恢复可能失败。两个创新点推动了这一结果。首先，该框架是逐路径的：不对数据施加任何随机模型假设。其次，对数行列式目标函数带有加性岭正则化：它消除了端点边界层，因此无需对候选集合进行修剪，并且通过调节岭参数可以弱化一致性条件。作为主要定理的应用，我们建立了在维度随样本量发散的渗透性因子模型中QML断点估计的一致性，且适用于完全一般的误差项——不必独立、也不必特异的。
tldr: 本文为多元时间序列断点的拟极大似然估计建立了尖锐的逐路径信噪比阈值，通过岭正则化消除端点边界层并免于候选集修剪，进而证明了维度发散的渗透性因子模型中QML断点估计的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a sharp pathwise signal-to-noise threshold for QML breakpoint estimation in multivariate time series, using ridge regularization to remove endpoint boundary layers without candidate trimming, and proves consistency in pervasive factor models with diverging dimensions.
